paragraphs: Rava bar Lima. Abaye challenged him (I have not found this). Rabbah bar Lima in Rav's name: Rosh Hashanah 4a; Megillah 13b, where it has Abba bar Lima (see there). She'erit Yosef likewise included him among Rav's pupils.
